review_scope: Revised core methodology and locked proposal cards; no skill-file changes, outcome reads, metric calculations or experiment runs.
independence_limits: Same model family and historical audit context; not statistically independent evidence. Did not read current-cycle screen results or seed-audit.json. Proposal cards were read after their initial commitment.

scenarios.scenario: Every fold and former holdout reused
scenarios.expected: Discovery-only ranking; no resplit, new agent or repeated bootstrap creates fresh confirmation.
scenarios.basis: empirical-validation.md: exposure lineage and Freeze before confirmation; contract fresh_confirmation_available=false.

scenarios.scenario: One positive training-seed pair and narrow chain-bootstrap interval
scenarios.expected: Provisional fixed-model observation; chain uncertainty does not cover recipe/seed variation, adaptive selection or transfer.
scenarios.basis: empirical-validation.md: Separate sources of uncertainty; research-artifacts.md: supported and replicated scope definitions.

scenarios.scenario: X symmetric and Y=X^2: zero population OLS slope with exact nonlinear predictability
scenarios.expected: A failed linear baseline does not veto a nonlinear hypothesis. Judge the registered predictive comparison.
scenarios.basis: Core objective_mode separates prediction from mechanism discovery and prunes by contract/evidence rather than model taste; contract explicitly forbids an unjustified OLS veto.

core_review.claim_gate_check: Practical deltas may allocate compute but are not significance thresholds. screen_failed is scoped to a tested recipe; supported must name its evidence scope; replicated needs claim-appropriate independent evidence. No false confirmation is licensed for this iteration.
core_review.remaining_limit: Correct instructions do not establish execution compliance. Preregistrations and final readouts still need concrete artifacts, comparisons, lineage and resource accounting.

concerns: G=Q+0.5*g*(P-Q) versus U=Q+0.5*(P-Q) changes average plain-teacher weight and row conditioning together. G beating U does not alone identify the benefit of conditional selection.

Q averages two distilled seeds whereas original C may use one distilled member. Register exact run IDs, checkpoint/cache hashes, alignment and the unchanged three-member remainder; comparisons answer different questions.
Cached teacher-function lift cannot show that a same-size student can learn it. The four fixed component seeds are not paired repetitions of a new student recipe.
before_run: Keep the proposed G/U/Q comparisons as a joint gate-versus-fixed-mixture screen and explicitly withhold a conditioning-only claim; alternatively preregister an additional static composition-matched control with its coefficient estimated from allowed training predictions before scoring. Any added arm consumes the trial budget.

Freeze exact pure-chain membership, cache/run identity, prediction row alignment, clipping after the final ensemble sum, missing-cache behavior and the definition of metric-weight coverage across both targets.
Retain the proposed no-retuning stop and distinguish the practical allocation gate from significance.
proposal_reviews.permitted_positive_claim: This fixed gated teacher mixture improves the registered cached ensemble comparison on reused discovery data, conditional on the fitted teacher artifacts.
not_established: conditional gating as the isolated cause
proposal_reviews.next_step_if_informative: A separately registered matched student/control training study, with fixed epochs and paired seeds, outside the current zero-GPU iteration.

concerns: A literal 85+17+17+17 microsecond cost is 136 us/row, while 48m52s over 39.4M rows is about 74.4 us/row. Matching by additive overhead alone would require negative overhead. If 85:17:17:17 is a ratio, its scale and overhead remain unidentified from one total runtime.
The candidate is described as cost-aware but lacks an exact transition rule. Prefix choice, safety allowance, rebuild cost, warm-up and measurement-window handling must be specified before outcomes.

The 39.4M-row replay contains 1970 sequences; available pure-fold cached sequences may be fewer. The mapping from simulated prefix schedules to scored validation units is unspecified. Repetition or weighting can alter pooled WP.

Synthetic time and cached validation quality are conditional on the assumed cost model and ordering. They do not validate actual public runtime, the public retained subset, or hidden score. A corrected cost estimate may yield the same final policy.
before_run: Freeze a nonnegative overhead and an explicit cost scale consistent with the calibration, or use independently measured heterogeneous timings. Do not tune both from desired outcomes.
Freeze exact old/candidate policy pseudocode including the old cold-window behavior, sequence-boundary updates, coefficient rescaling and no-recovery rule; identify any intentional differences.
Freeze the schedule-to-cache mapping and weights, report both predeclared orderings and all four speed scenarios without selecting the favorable one.
Treat any optimistic fixed-prefix oracle/regret as a descriptive bound over reused data, not a deployable target-informed policy.
proposal_reviews.permitted_positive_claim: Under the registered synthetic cost scenarios, a specified cost-aware policy improves the runtime/retained-quality tradeoff within the fixed prefix set.
not_established: causal attribution of earlier leaderboard differences
proposal_reviews.next_step_if_informative: An isolated governor implementation with measured per-member costs on relevant CPU paths and independent runtime/parity checks; no automatic submission promotion.

concerns: Cached early/late error profiles confound context age with sequence content and cannot identify a benefit from random-origin training.
A controlled inference reset experiment diagnoses context sensitivity but still does not establish that training augmentation will help.
proposal_reviews.acceptable_screen: None in the current cached-only proposal. A future bounded reset-origin comparison must fix rows, origins, burn-in and valid information; a training study must additionally match exposure and optimizer updates.
proposal_reviews.permitted_claim: A distinct untested training hypothesis with weak prior evidence, not a supported improvement.
proposal_reviews.next_step_if_informative: Separate preregistration only if a discriminating test fits a later authorized budget.

disposition: I1 and I2 may proceed as bounded discovery/engineering screens after the listed pre-outcome specification choices. I3 stays deferred. This review supplies no empirical support, no confirmation and no submission recommendation.
